Set this claim to Waiting on Customer.

I can't set this one to **Waiting on Customer** because that status only exists for service requests. A claim moves through New, Under Investigation, Appraisal, Approved, Payment Issued, then Closed or Denied.

[00002216](/lightning/r/500aj00003jLAOcAAO/view) is currently **Under Investigation**. According to the last note (30 Sep), it's waiting on the mitigation invoice and the contractor's rebuild estimate.

If you'd like, I can move it to another claim status. I could also add a file note or a follow-up task with Chinedu Okafor to show you're waiting on him.
